I’m very interested in the work, but I can’t and won’t share my Social Security number, date of birth, or bank account/routing numbers over chat or via external links. Please do one of the following so we can proceed safely:
1) Initiate payment through FreelanceHub escrow/payments so we can onboard securely.

Also, I won’t follow the external links in your message — they look like third-party sites. Please confirm the company name, official website, and a point of contact email at your corporate domain. Once we have a secure onboarding path and a signed contract or invoice, I’ll provide whatever verified documents are required through the appropriate secure channel.

Thanks — looking forward to clarifying scope, timeline, and deliverables so we can get started.

actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit. I can deliver a responsive analytics dashboard with real-time visualizations, role-based auth, and dark-mode support.

A few quick questions so I can scope this precisely:
1) Do you have API documentation or a sandbox I can review for the REST endpoints and streaming/real-time requirements?
2) What authentication method do you currently use (JWT, OAuth, etc.) and will I be integrating with your existing auth service?
3) Are there any existing design guidelines or Figma files to follow, or should I propose UI mocks?
4) Do you expect the charts to be client-rendered (D3/Chart.js) or server-side aggregated for performance at scale?

Budget and timing: your $5k–$6k budget for a ~4 week timeline is reasonable depending on final scope. I can prepare a short proposal outlining milestones, deliverables, and a firm estimate once I review the API and confirm requirements.

Next steps: I’m happy to hop on a 30-minute call to clarify scope and timelines. Please share a few time slots that work for you (I’m in US Central time) or send a calendar invite. Also, if you can share the API docs or a brief spec, I’ll draft a proposal within 48 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing more and potentially working together.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
